decision.reason: [ev-518a56c0e2c1] is only a one-line bugfix title. It names no setting, field, version range or symptom, and it does not say whether the "flake" happened in customer clusters or only in tests. Nearby items in the same section are test fixes ([ev-aa6e55e47c2f] is an E2E test fix; [ev-f21609ff075e] is another "scheduling ... flake"), so this one may also be test-only. If so, no environment is exposed, and the proposed runtime-behavior-gap leaf would wrongly flag every environment. Deciding this needs the PR #6491 description or diff, showing whether the fix changes runtime controller code and under what conditions the flake occurred.
